name: GoingTo2014 (ADVENT CALENDAR)
desc:
GoingTo2014 is an old roblox simulator of the years 2014E to 2015L. There are more than 35 games to play here. Buy items from the catalog to customize your character. Make your own group and find other people like you. Upload your own clothing.
This game is not done so expect a lots of bugs, inaccurate stuff and missing features.

The currency in this game (Robux/Tickets) is not the actual Roblox currency so any changes to your in-game account balance wont affect your real Roblox one.
